name: Bhujangasana
description: A prone backbend that opens the chest, strengthens the spine, and improves lung capacity.
benefits: Stretches chest, lungs, shoulders, and abdomen

steps.instruction: Lie flat on your stomach with forehead on the mat, hands by your chest.
steps.voice_prompt: Lie flat on your stomach. Place your palms flat on the floor beside your chest.

steps.instruction: Place hips flat, tuck pubic bone down, and suck navel in.
steps.voice_prompt: Press your hip and legs down, tucking your pubic bone in and drawing your belly to your spine.

steps.instruction: Inhale, press palms down, and roll shoulders back to lift chest.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale, bring your shoulders up and roll them back, lifting your chest off the floor.

steps.instruction: Straighten arms to 80 percent, elbows slightly bent.
steps.voice_prompt: Straighten your arms to eighty percent, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.

steps.instruction: Pull mat backward with hands, push chest forward and lift chin.
steps.voice_prompt: Pull your mat backward with your palms to push your chest forward and lift your chin.

steps.instruction: Exhale slowly, lower chest down, and relax.
steps.voice_prompt: Exhale slowly, lower your torso back down to the floor, and relax completely.
